items.title: Jim Cullum interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 12, 2007
items.q: that’s all I wanted to do was play the blues, like Louis Armstrong.

ctx.x: And I wanted to be a blues player, that was all I cared about, to play the blues, that’s all I wanted to do was play the blues, like Louis Armstrong.
That’s an important moment, that you could even hear that thing and go for it.
